title: Positive lower bound on halting time
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, let $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $p\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Q}$. Suppose that on every input $x$, $N$ halts on every branch within $T(|x|)$ steps and outputs the membership indicator for $L$ with probability at least $p(|x|)$. Then $T(m)\ge 1$ for every $m\in\mathbb{N}$.

$L$ is a language of binary strings
